text: Build a house for a fox using only 3 kinds of blocks.
hint: Foxes sleep in the day, so give it a cozy bed.

text: Build something that floats on water.
hint: It could be a raft, a boat or a whole island.

text: Build a tiny copy of your real house.
hint: Count your windows and doors first.

text: Build a bakery that sells cake.
hint: Add a counter and somewhere to sit.

text: Build a secret hideout in a tree.
hint: Nobody should be able to see the door.

text: Build a castle gate with a bridge over water.
hint: Make the gate wide enough for a horse.

text: Build a lighthouse on a rock.
hint: Put a light at the very top.

text: Build a cabin with a fireplace.
hint: A campfire looks great in a fireplace.

text: Build a pet shop with three animals in it.
hint: Each animal needs its own pen or tank.

text: Build a giant cupcake.
hint: Use one colour for the cake and another for the icing.

text: Build a house that is taller than it is wide.
hint: Stack the rooms on top of each other.

text: Build a home for a frog by a pond.
hint: Lily pads go on the water.

text: Build a desert market with three stalls.
hint: Wool on top of fences makes a nice shade.

text: Build a snowy hut for a polar bear.
hint: Polar bears live on ice, so add an icy floor.

text: Build a haunted house that is more silly than scary.
hint: Jack o'lanterns make good windows.

text: Build a fairy house inside a giant flower.
hint: Start with a big stem, then add the petals.

text: Build a bridge across a river using no wood.
hint: Stone and stone bricks make strong bridges.

text: Build a treehouse with two rooms.
hint: Join the rooms with a little bridge.

text: Build a train station.
hint: Rails go along the ground. Add a bench to wait on.

text: Build a beach hut on stilts.
hint: Logs make good stilts.

text: Build a house that is round, not square.
hint: Make each layer a circle. Start small.

text: Build a home for a turtle on the beach.
hint: Turtles lay eggs on sand.

text: Build a library with tall bookshelves.
hint: Add a ladder to reach the top shelves.

text: Build a garden that spells your name in flowers.
hint: Plan the letters on the ground first.

text: Build a giant mushroom you can live in.
hint: The cap is the roof. The stem is the door.

text: Build a stable for two horses.
hint: Give each horse a stall and some hay.

text: Build a pyramid.
hint: Each layer is one block smaller on every side.

text: Build a snow fort for a snowball fight.
hint: Leave holes in the walls to throw through.

text: Build a cafe with an outdoor patio.
hint: Fences with a pressure plate on top make tables.

text: Build a wizard tower with a pointy roof.
hint: Make each floor of the roof a little smaller.

text: Build a pirate ship.
hint: Wool makes great sails.

text: Build a house using only one kind of block.
hint: Use shapes like stairs and slabs to add detail.

text: Build a playground with a slide and swings.
hint: Stairs going down make a good slide.

text: Build a fish tank in a wall.
hint: Glass on the front, water inside, and a fish or two.

text: Build a bedroom for a giant.
hint: Make the bed five times bigger than a real one.

text: Build a mini golf hole with a ramp.
hint: A hopper or a hole in the ground can be the cup.

text: Build a farm with five different crops.
hint: Every crop needs water nearby.

text: Build a rocket ship ready to launch.
hint: Make it tall and pointy, with fins at the bottom.

text: Build a hot air balloon.
hint: Wool for the balloon, a little wood basket under it.

text: Build an ice palace.
hint: Packed ice and snow, with tall pointy towers.

text: Build a house in the side of a hill.
hint: Dig into the hill and add a round door.

text: Build a windmill.
hint: The sails can be fences or wool.

text: Build a bus stop for villagers.
hint: Add a bench and a roof.

text: Build a dragon statue.
hint: Start with the body, then the head, wings and tail.

text: Build a cozy reading nook.
hint: Bookshelves, a seat and a lamp.

text: Build a home for bees with lots of flowers.
hint: Bees need flowers nearby to make honey.

text: Build a museum with three things on show.
hint: Item frames are great for showing things.

text: Build a giant ice cream cone.
hint: Terracotta makes a good cone colour.

text: Build a waterfall that falls into a pool.
hint: Put the water source at the top.

text: Build a house in only 10 minutes.
hint: Walls, a roof and a door. Go!

text: Build a door that nobody can find.
hint: A bookshelf wall or a painting can hide it.

text: Build a sailboat statue in the sea.
hint: It doesn't have to move. It just has to look good.

text: Build a clock tower.
hint: The clock face can be made of wool.

text: Build a house for a cat with a scratching post.
hint: Cats like to sit on beds and chests.

text: Build a rainbow bridge.
hint: One stripe of each colour of wool.

text: Build a cave entrance with a hidden treasure room.
hint: Put a chest at the very back.

text: Build a campsite with tents and a campfire.
hint: Wool on fences makes a tent shape.

text: Build a home for an axolotl.
hint: Axolotls need water to live in.

text: Build a giant version of your favourite food.
hint: Pick the colours first.

text: Build a fire station with a tall door for the truck.
hint: Red wool or bricks look good.

text: Build a house with no straight walls.
hint: Push some blocks in and some out.

text: Build a snowman family.
hint: Make them different sizes.

text: Build a mine entrance with rails going in.
hint: Torches every few blocks light the way.

text: Build a flower shop.
hint: Flower pots in the window show what's for sale.

text: Build a tiny house that fits in a 5 by 5 space.
hint: Every block counts. Can you fit a bed?

text: Build a big house that is 20 blocks long.
hint: Plan the rooms before you build the walls.

text: Build a home for a sniffer.
hint: Sniffers are big, so make the door big.

text: Build a ship in a bottle.
hint: Glass for the bottle, a tiny boat inside.

text: Build a desert well with a roof.
hint: Sandstone and a little water in the middle.

text: Build a spooky graveyard that is actually a garden.
hint: Use flowers to make it friendly.

text: Build a fountain in a town square.
hint: Water flows down from the top.

text: Build an underwater house.
hint: Fill the inside with sand first, then dig it out.

text: Build an archway made of leaves.
hint: Leaves you place stay forever.

text: Build a stage for a concert.
hint: Note blocks can play the music.

text: Build a home for a panda.
hint: Pandas love bamboo.

text: Build a lookout tower on a mountain.
hint: A ladder inside, a lookout on top.

text: Build a giant sword stuck in the ground.
hint: The blade, the handle and the guard.

text: Build a house that a villager would love.
hint: Give it a bed and a job block.

text: Build a pumpkin patch with a scarecrow.
hint: A carved pumpkin makes a good head.

text: Build a mailbox and a post office.
hint: A chest makes a good mailbox.

text: Build a home for a parrot.
hint: Parrots like jungle trees and seeds.

text: Build an igloo with a secret basement.
hint: Hide the way down under a trapdoor.

text: Build a fairy ring of mushrooms.
hint: Make a circle on the grass.

text: Build a huge chair and table, like you're tiny.
hint: Make the table as tall as a house.

text: Build a race track around your house.
hint: Rails and a minecart make a ride around it.

text: Build a lantern-lit path through the woods.
hint: Put a lantern every few blocks.

text: Build an outdoor cinema.
hint: A big wall of wool for the screen, rows of seats.

text: Build a home for a llama.
hint: Llamas can wear a carpet. Add some hay.

text: Build a crystal cave.
hint: Amethyst and glass make it sparkle.

text: Build a garden maze.
hint: Leaves make tall hedges. Put a prize in the middle.

text: Build an animal hospital.
hint: One room for each kind of animal.

text: Build a picnic spot by a lake.
hint: A blanket made of carpet and a basket.

text: Build a snow globe.
hint: Glass dome, snow inside, a tiny house in the middle.

text: Build a pizza shop.
hint: Red and yellow wool make a pizza sign.

text: Build a bunk bed room for a sleepover.
hint: Beds stack with a slab in between.

text: Build a tree that's a different colour than normal.
hint: Use wool or concrete for the leaves.

text: Build an old ruin, half fallen down.
hint: Mossy and cracked stone bricks look old.

text: Build a home for a goat on a cliff.
hint: Goats love high places.

text: Build something that matches the weather today.
hint: Look outside first.

text: Build a giant letter of your name.
hint: Make it at least 10 blocks tall.

text: Build a toy store.
hint: Show the toys on shelves in the window.

text: Build a cozy winter cabin with lights in the windows.
hint: Lanterns inside make the windows glow.

text: Build a home for a mob nobody likes.
hint: Maybe a creeper deserves a house too.

text: Build a garden on a roof.
hint: Grass, flowers and a little bench up high.

text: Build a dock with a boat tied to it.
hint: Fences make good posts.

text: Build a castle with four towers.
hint: One tower in each corner, walls in between.

text: Build a vegetable stand with a sign.
hint: Put the crops in barrels or composters.
